name: Mail Bell
summary: Rings when new mail arrives and reminds you at login which of your other characters still have letters waiting.
logoPrompt: A small polished brass hand bell tilted mid-ring, standing in front of a sealed cream-coloured envelope with a red wax seal
description: **Mail Bell rings when new mail arrives and, when you log in, tells you which of your other characters have mail waiting.**
## Features
- Plays a bell and prints one chat line the moment new mail reaches you.
- The bell uses the Master channel, so you hear it even with sound effects muted.
- Mail that was already there at login stays quiet, and the bell never rings twice within 30 seconds.
- Remembers which of your characters have unread mail and names them in one chat line after login.
## How to use
Install it and play. Type `/mb` (or `/mailbell`) to see your characters with mail, the settings and all commands.
## In detail
### The new mail notification

When the game's new-mail flag switches on, Mail Bell plays the alarm clock sound on the Master channel and prints "You have new mail." in chat, the line also with the sound off. For the first 10 seconds after you log in or reload, it only notes what is already there, so old mail never rings. After a loading screen it keeps track, so mail that arrived in the meantime still rings. It rings again only after the flag went off and on again, never within 30 seconds.
### Mail on your other characters

Whenever the character you play has new mail, Mail Bell writes that down. The note is cleared when you empty the mailbox, or when you close it and the game shows no new mail left. Five seconds after login, one chat line names your other characters with mail waiting, the oldest first, for example "Mail waiting on: Brakk (Silvermoon), Yubi". Characters on another realm get the realm in brackets.
### Commands
- `/mb` – lists your other characters with mail and shows both settings.
- `/mb sound on` or `off` – switches the bell.
- `/mb login on` or `off` – switches the list after login.
- `/mb forget Name-Realm` – removes a character from the list; upper and lower case do not matter. The character you are playing cannot be removed.
## Good to know
- Works on Retail only. No combat data, it only reads the new-mail flag and your inbox.
- It cannot see mail sent to a character you are not playing. A character is listed only if it had unread mail when you last played it.
- It never opens, takes or sends mail.
- The addon is in English.
- The settings and the character list are saved for your whole account; a character stays in the saved data until you remove it with `/mb forget`.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
